title: Project
description: A project as update_project returns it (since 0.13.1); list_projects adds counts. A task is in at most one project (its projectId); labels are free tags across projects. Fields that are not set are left out. Fields may be added; none are removed or retyped within a major version.

id.description: Stable project id, the projectId of its tasks

name.description: 1 to 50 characters, unique among the user's projects in any case, archived ones included; never "none"

color.description: Color token; the apps pick the shade for the theme. Missing: neutral

note.description: What the project is about, for people and agents (up to 2000 characters)

position.description: Order in the menu, lowest first

archived.description: true: out of the menu and of the choice for new tasks; its tasks stay where they are

archivedAt.description: When it was archived, Unix time in milliseconds; only on archived projects

clientId.description: clientId of the operation that created the project
